mouse.en: A small mouse appeared near the garden shed after sunset.
mouse.zh: 日落後，一隻小老鼠出現在花園小屋附近。

mouth.en: Please cover your mouth when you cough in the classroom.
mouth.zh: 在教室咳嗽時請遮住嘴巴。

movement.en: The sudden movement of the curtain caught everyone's attention.
movement.zh: 窗簾突然的動作吸引了大家的注意。

mow.en: They mow the school lawn every Friday before sports practice.
mow.zh: 他們每週五在體育練習前修剪校園草地。

mud.en: Heavy rain left thick mud along the hiking path.
mud.zh: 大雨在健行步道上留下厚厚的泥巴。

muddy.en: Our shoes became muddy after walking through the wet field.
muddy.zh: 走過潮濕的田地後，我們的鞋子變得泥濘。

mug.en: She poured warm tea into her favorite ceramic mug.
mug.zh: 她把熱茶倒進自己最喜歡的陶瓷杯。

mule.en: The mule carried supplies along the narrow mountain trail.
mule.zh: 騾子沿著狹窄山路運送補給品。

multiply.en: To multiply these numbers, follow the steps shown on the board.
multiply.zh: 要將這些數字相乘，請依照黑板上的步驟。

mumble.en: He began to mumble because he felt nervous during the presentation.
mumble.zh: 他在報告時因緊張而開始含糊低語。

municipal.en: The municipal library opened a new study room for students.
municipal.zh: 市立圖書館為學生開放了一間新的自習室。

murmur.en: A quiet murmur spread through the audience before the concert began.
murmur.zh: 音樂會開始前，觀眾席傳出低聲交談。

muse.en: The peaceful lake can muse artists seeking ideas for new paintings.
muse.zh: 寧靜的湖泊能啟發尋找新畫作靈感的藝術家。

museum.en: Our class visited the science museum during the field trip.
museum.zh: 我們班在校外教學時參觀了科學博物館。

mushroom.en: A tiny mushroom grew beside the fallen tree after the rain.
mushroom.zh: 雨後，一朵小蘑菇長在倒下的樹旁。

musical.en: The school musical attracted a large audience on opening night.
musical.zh: 學校音樂劇首演當晚吸引了許多觀眾。

musician.en: The young musician practiced the violin before every performance.
musician.zh: 那位年輕音樂家每次演出前都練習小提琴。

mustard.en: He added a little mustard to his sandwich at lunch.
mustard.zh: 午餐時他在三明治裡加了一點芥末。

mute.en: Please mute your microphone while another student is speaking online.
mute.zh: 其他同學在線上發言時請將麥克風靜音。

myself.en: I reminded myself to check every answer before submitting the test.
myself.zh: 我提醒自己交卷前要檢查每一題答案。

mysterious.en: A mysterious light appeared above the hills late at night.
mysterious.zh: 深夜時，山丘上方出現一道神秘的光。

mystery.en: The novel presents a mystery that becomes clearer chapter by chapter.
mystery.zh: 這本小說呈現一個隨章節逐漸明朗的謎團。

myth.en: The history teacher explained how a myth differs from verified evidence.
myth.zh: 歷史老師解釋神話與經過驗證的證據有何不同。

nag.en: Repeated reminders can nag students instead of helping them focus.
nag.zh: 反覆提醒可能會讓學生感到煩躁，而非幫助專心。

nail.en: A loose nail was sticking out of the wooden bench.
nail.zh: 一根鬆動的釘子從木椅上突出來。

naive.en: It was naive to assume every online claim was completely accurate.
naive.zh: 假設網路上的每個說法都完全正確是很天真的。

namely.en: We need two materials, namely paper and clear tape, for the project.
namely.zh: 這個專題需要兩種材料，也就是紙和透明膠帶。

nap.en: A short nap helped him feel more alert in the afternoon.
nap.zh: 短暫午睡讓他下午精神更好。

napkin.en: She placed a napkin beside each plate before dinner began.
napkin.zh: 晚餐開始前，她在每個盤子旁放了一張餐巾。

narrate.en: Students will narrate the short film in their own words.
narrate.zh: 學生將用自己的話為這部短片旁白。

narrative.en: The writer uses a clear narrative to connect the historical events.
narrative.zh: 作者用清楚的敘事串連這些歷史事件。

narrator.en: The narrator describes the village from a child's point of view.
narrator.zh: 敘事者從孩子的角度描述這座村莊。

nasty.en: A nasty smell came from the trash bin after the storm.
nasty.zh: 暴風雨後，垃圾桶傳出難聞的氣味。

nationalism.en: The class discussed how nationalism influenced several nineteenth-century movements.
nationalism.zh: 全班討論民族主義如何影響十九世紀的多場運動。

nationality.en: The form asks for your nationality along with basic contact information.
nationality.zh: 這份表格除了基本聯絡資料，也會詢問國籍。

naughty.en: The story features a naughty puppy that keeps hiding everyone's socks.
naughty.zh: 故事裡有一隻調皮小狗，總是把大家的襪子藏起來。

navigate.en: The map helped us navigate the unfamiliar streets near the station.
navigate.zh: 地圖幫助我們在車站附近陌生的街道中找到方向。

navigation.en: Satellite navigation has made long road trips easier for many drivers.
navigation.zh: 衛星導航讓許多駕駛的長途旅行更方便。

navy.en: The museum exhibit explains the history of the country's navy.
navy.zh: 博物館展覽介紹該國海軍的歷史。

nearsighted.en: A nearsighted student may need glasses to see the board clearly.
nearsighted.zh: 近視的學生可能需要眼鏡才能清楚看見黑板。

neat.en: Her notes are neat enough for everyone in the group to read.
neat.zh: 她的筆記很整齊，小組每個人都看得懂。

necessity.en: Clean water is a basic necessity for every community.
necessity.zh: 乾淨的水是每個社區的基本必需品。

necklace.en: The artist displayed a handmade necklace at the weekend market.
necklace.zh: 那位藝術家在週末市集展示一條手工項鍊。

necktie.en: He wore a blue necktie for the formal school ceremony.
necktie.zh: 他在正式的學校典禮上戴了一條藍色領帶。

needle.en: The compass needle slowly turned toward the north.
needle.zh: 指南針的指針慢慢轉向北方。

needy.en: The charity collects school supplies for needy families each year.
needy.zh: 這個慈善團體每年為有需要的家庭募集學用品。

neglect.en: Do not neglect small errors when checking an important report.
neglect.zh: 檢查重要報告時，不要忽略小錯誤。

nephew.en: My nephew enjoys building model airplanes during school vacations.
nephew.zh: 我的姪子喜歡在學校假期組裝模型飛機。

nerve.en: It took some nerve to speak before such a large audience.
nerve.zh: 在那麼多觀眾面前發言需要一些勇氣。

nest.en: A bird built its nest under the roof of the shelter.
nest.zh: 一隻鳥在遮棚屋頂下築了巢。
